title: Not Absorbent
text:
Not Absorbent. Gorgeous springy colors. 100% cotton. They are nice and absorbent. The stitching seems solid even though they are made in India. For my taste they are a little on the small size. They are a little smaller than the size of a standard washcloth. With shrinkage, they are kind of small. Otherwise a great addition to any cooks kitchen.

UPDATE: I have changed my review from 5 to 3 stars. After washing and using these for several weeks, they are NOT absorbent at all and are pretty, but useless for washing dishes. 100% cotton should be better than this, so I am skeptical that they truly are cotton and not some blend.
